topography.project_purpose: Canonical Bridge. Structurally: 38 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 3 ERC20 tokens, 1 ERC721 NFT, 1 ERC1155 multi-token; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 4 functional families. Its contracts share 7 common project-authored base contract(s) (addressmanager, rollupaddresscache, addresscache). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
